fields.description: Record flag byte at SRAM 0x0E000000: cleared to 0 by the init path of FUN_080f10c4; zero in the default record.
fields.evidence: FUN_080f10c4 clears *_DAT_080f1200 = 0 (line 2933) after loading the 16-byte SRAM record into the RAM buffer at _DAT_080f1200 (line 2912); baseline.sav byte 0 is 0x00.
fields.name: boot_record_flag

fields.description: Status flags byte: bit 1 records whether block token B (param_4) is nonzero; bit 0 is forced to 0 and the upper 6 bits are preserved across the init path.
fields.evidence: FUN_080f10c4 line 2934: puVar2[1] = old_buf[1] & 0xfc | (((-param_4 | param_4) >> 0x1f) << 1); caller FUN_080d8b74 passes param_4 = 0, matching baseline.sav byte 1 = 0x00.
fields.name: boot_param_sign_flags

fields.description: Low 9 bits of 18-bit block token A: validated as (buf_u16[6] << 9 | buf_u16[4]) == param_2 and re-derived as (param_2 + 3) & 0x1fc on the init path.
fields.evidence: FUN_080f10c4 validation line 2914 and init line 2935 (*(ushort *)(puVar2 + 4) = (param_2 + 3) & 0x1fc); boot caller FUN_080d8b74 supplies param_2 = _DAT_080d8ba0; baseline.sav bytes 4-5 are 0x0000.
fields.name: block_token_a_low

fields.description: High bits of 18-bit block token A: validated as the upper half of (buf_u16[6] << 9 | buf_u16[4]) == param_2 and re-derived as ((param_2 + 3) >> 9) masked with _DAT_080f1210.
fields.evidence: FUN_080f10c4 validation line 2914 and init line 2937 (*(ushort *)(puVar2 + 6) = (param_2 + 3 >> 9) & _DAT_080f1210); baseline.sav bytes 6-7 are 0x0000.
fields.name: block_token_a_high

fields.description: Low 9 bits of 18-bit block token B: validated as (buf_u16[10] << 9 | buf_u16[8]) == param_4 and re-derived as (param_4 + 3) & 0x1fc on the init path.
fields.evidence: FUN_080f10c4 validation line 2915 and init line 2938 (*(ushort *)(puVar2 + 8) = (param_4 + 3) & 0x1fc); boot caller FUN_080d8b74 passes param_4 = 0, matching baseline.sav bytes 8-9 = 0x0000.
fields.name: block_token_b_low

fields.description: High bits of 18-bit block token B: validated as the upper half of (buf_u16[10] << 9 | buf_u16[8]) == param_4 and re-derived as ((param_4 + 3) >> 9) masked with _DAT_080f1210.
fields.evidence: FUN_080f10c4 validation line 2915 and init line 2939 (*(ushort *)(puVar2 + 10) = (param_4 + 3 >> 9) & _DAT_080f1210); baseline.sav bytes 10-11 are 0x0000.
fields.name: block_token_b_high

fields.description: Sequence/order word: the init path rewrites its low four nibbles to 0, 1, 2, 3 in order (low half becomes 0x3210) while preserving the upper 16 bits; untouched on the valid-record path.
fields.evidence: FUN_080f10c4 lines 2940-2946 loop (u32 at puVar2 + 0xc gets nibble i set to i for i = 0..3); FUN_080f10c4 line 2964 also reads _DAT_080f12d4 + 0xc in the same nibble domain; baseline.sav bytes 12-15 are 0x00000000, i.e. the init path did not run on the captured boot.
fields.name: slot_sequence_pattern
